title: A pending batch whose grant recovery finds closed without a receipt waits 30 minutes before its members are told
outcome: When the host learns that the grant carrying a pending batch closed with no receipt naming the gate's record, it drains that grant's pending batches at once, with an explicit line to each member. Two cases: a rebind's session_status reports no open grant after the closing checkpoint's answer was lost, so clear_engram_stale_binding_record clears it; or another checkpoint of the same grant answers with a report lacking the gate's Test input. Today the pending batch is settled only by a Checkpointed receipt, an explicit refusal, or the 30-minute expiry, so members wait 30 minutes and are told only "not confirmed within 30 minutes".
acceptance: A pending batch whose grant recovery finds closed without a receipt waits 30 minutes before its members are told is done
